items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: there's only about one fellow that I know of, around here, who might have one, Bill, there's a fellow by the name of Emil Gonzalez

ctx.x: Mark, do you remember the first foot pedal for the bass drum that you ever saw? Yeah. About when?

I can't remember when, the date, but I can describe it to you. It had a long metal rod. And on the end of the rod was the beater. And then there was a, in the end of the beater, there was a little screw thing that was sort of a, triangle in shape. And you fit a leather strap through that. And you fit a leather strap through that.
